_doc: ServiceMarketing tunables (#307, parent #297). The two service-marketing arms, kept distinct from sales advertising. RETENTION campaigns lift the installed base's return rate (added to the return roll's `convenience` term, which also slows the no-return defection path); pick one campaign or none. The CONQUEST special is a single category-targeted push the player aims at a job category (e.g. tires_brakes = a 'brake special'): it raises conquest volume (scales ServiceDemand's serviceMarketing input by `volumeBoost`) and multiplies the promoted category's weight in the incoming mix by `1 + categoryBias`, so you can manufacture demand to clear over-stocked parts. Each active arm debits its `dailyCost` from Economy each day. All magnitudes are placeholders tuned in the S14 balance pass (#286).

retentionCampaigns.label: Loyalty mailer
retentionCampaigns.blurb: Periodic service reminders plus a small loyalty perk nudge owners back to the bay.

retentionCampaigns.blurb: Sell prepaid maintenance plans up front — the strongest retention lever, and the priciest.
